## Description

Implements the group-review activity (S11) of `group-investment-review`: ranks concurrent proposals for Group IC and screens portfolio overlap at group level, distinct from entity-level review. Does not cover portfolio-fit scoring (portfolio-fit-assessment) or affiliate transaction screens (intra-group-transaction-compliance). Use when: "group review", "group IC", "proposal ranking", "capital allocation priority".
